Narrative

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 311901ZMAR23 - [ 1.4a ] ([ 1.4a ] FLT), A 2-SHIP OF F-16CM, TOOK
OFF FROM PRINCE SULTAN AIR BASE (OEPS) ISO OPERATION INHERENT RESOLVE. 1.4a
FLT WAS FRAGGED TO CONDUCT DCA IN THE ESSA (2100-0000). MISSION WAS FLOWN AS
FRAGGED.

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 2007Z- 1.4a FLT ENTERED IZ AIRSPACE. NFTR.

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 2058Z - 1.4a FLT ENTERED SY AIRSPACE AND CHECKED ONSTA W/
KINGPIN TO CONDUCT DCA IN THE ESSA.

(S//NF) 2302Z - 1.4a FLT OBSERVED MULTIPLE POSS UAPS. (SEE UAP)

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 0000Z - 1.4a FLT CHECKED OFFSTA W/ KINGPIN AND PROCEEDED
TO RTB (OEPS). NSTR.

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 0046Z - 1.4a FLT EXITED IZ AIRSPACE.

(S//REL TO USA, FVEY) 0148Z - 1.4a FLT LANDED AT OEPS W/ ESD AT 0215Z. NFTR.//


(S/REL IDO) Mission Narrative

GENTEXT/UAP

• UAP Description (e.g., size, shape, color, markings, recognizable features): (S//NF) STARTING AT
2302:05Z 1.4a FLT OBSERVED SEVERAL BRIGHT OBJECTS MANUEVERING QUICKLY
WEST TO EAST NE OF RLZ. 1.4a FLT WOULD OBTAIN POSS UAP ON TARGETING POD (TV
MODE) FOR APPROX 20S BEFORE OBJECT WOULD BECOME DIM AND DISAPPEAR FROM
TARGETING POD. NONE OF THE OBJECTS WERE SEEN IN ANY FORMATIONS AS
PREVIOUSLY SEEN IN PRIOR SORTIES. NFTR.

ANALYST COMMENT: 1.4a FLT COMPARED TARGETING POD BETWEEN POSS UAP AND
STAR. RESULTS WERE DIFFERENT.
